citations.quote: The primary pharmacology studies show the possible mechanism of action of mirabegron is through bladder relaxation during the filling phase and inhibition of the frequency of non-voiding activity, thus enhancing urine storage.

Pre-clinical studies have shown that activation of beta-AR in the bladder trigone facilitates urine storage through flattening and lengthening of the bladder base.
